_comment: Windows system junk. See docs/RULES.md for the format.

description.en: Files programs left in your temp folder. Files from the last 24 hours are kept.
description.zh_CN: 程序留在临时文件夹里的文件。最近 24 小时内的文件会保留。

description.en: Windows' own temp folder. Files from the last 24 hours are kept.
description.zh_CN: Windows 自己的临时文件夹。最近 24 小时内的文件会保留。

description.en: Update packages that were already installed. Windows downloads them again if needed.
description.zh_CN: 已经安装过的更新包。需要时 Windows 会重新下载。

description.en: Update pieces Windows keeps to share with other PCs.
description.zh_CN: Windows 为了和其他电脑共享更新而保留的文件。

description.en: Memory snapshots saved when an app crashed. Only useful to developers.
description.zh_CN: 程序崩溃时保存的内存快照，一般只对开发者有用。

description.en: Windows Error Reporting files for your account.
description.zh_CN: Windows 错误报告留下的文件。

description.en: System-wide Windows Error Reporting archive and queue.
description.zh_CN: 系统级的错误报告存档和队列。

description.en: Saved after a blue screen. Keep them if you are still troubleshooting crashes.
description.zh_CN: 蓝屏后保存的文件。如果还在排查蓝屏原因，请先保留。

description.en: Explorer rebuilds these automatically. Files in use are skipped.
description.zh_CN: 资源管理器会自动重建。正在使用的文件会跳过。

description.en: DirectX, NVIDIA and AMD shader caches. Games rebuild them; the first launch may be slower.
description.zh_CN: DirectX、NVIDIA、AMD 的着色器缓存。游戏会自动重建，首次启动可能稍慢。

description.en: Cache used by Windows components and older apps.
description.zh_CN: Windows 组件和老程序使用的网络缓存。

description.en: Permanently empties the Recycle Bin on all drives. This cannot be undone.
description.zh_CN: 清空所有磁盘的回收站。此操作无法撤销。

description.en: Left after a Windows upgrade. Remove it in Settings > System > Storage > Temporary files ('Previous Windows installation'). You can no longer roll back afterwards.
description.zh_CN: 系统升级后留下的旧系统。请在 设置 > 系统 > 存储 > 临时文件 中勾选“以前的 Windows 安装”删除。删除后无法回退到旧版本。
